content:
If you're re-explaining yourself to Claude every session, you're using it at maybe 20% of what it does.

You never had to do that twice.

Here's the setup that fixes it: 👇

---

1/ Create a project

Open Projects in the left sidebar and create a new one.

Name it for one specific area of work, not a category. "Newsletter" beats "Writing." Narrow projects give better output than broad ones, because the instructions can actually be specific.

---

2/ Write the instructions once

Every project has its own custom instructions that apply to every chat inside it.

Put in what you'd otherwise retype: who you are, who you're writing for, your tone, your format preferences, and a short list of things to never do. That last list does more work than the rest combined.

---

3/ Upload the files that carry your context

Projects have a knowledge base. Files you upload there are available to every conversation in that project.

Two worth having: a document about you and your work, and one with samples of your actual writing. Style samples beat any adjective you could use to describe your voice.

---

4/ Understand what actually carries over

This is the part most people get wrong.

Context is not shared automatically between separate chats inside a project. Only what's in the project instructions and the knowledge base is available everywhere.

So if something matters more than once, it doesn't belong in a chat. It belongs in a file.

---

5/ Start a new chat per task

Because the shared context lives in the project, not the conversation, you can start fresh whenever a thread gets messy.

You lose nothing. The setup is still there. This is the actual payoff of the whole structure.

---

6/ Update it when something annoys you twice

That's the maintenance rule. If you've corrected the same thing in two different chats, it belongs in the instructions.

Ten seconds now, or that correction forever.

---

✅ Worth doing for anything you'll come back to weekly

❌ Not worth it for one-off tasks you'll never repeat

Setup takes twenty minutes. The re-explaining tax you're paying now costs more than that every week.

I write about this kind of thing daily in my newsletter, Incredible AI. It's free.

What would go in your instructions file?
